s. (of a ball in sport) not in the possession or control of any player
a. not tight; not closely constrained or constricted or constricting
loosest.translation: a. 松的( loose的最高级 ); 不精确的; 自由的; 疏松的

loosestrife.definition:
n. any of numerous herbs and subshrubs of the genus Lythrum
n. any of various herbs and subshrubs of the genus Lysimachia
loosestrife.translation:
n. [植] 珍珠菜,千屈菜
a. 千屈科植物的

loosey-goosey.translation: a. 极松的, 十分松弛的

loosing.definition:
v grant freedom to; free from confinement
v turn loose or free from restraint
v make loose or looser
v become loose or looser or less tight
loosing.translation: n. 赦免的行为；（英）21岁生日庆祝会

loot.definition:
n. goods or money obtained illegally
v. take illegally; of intellectual property
loot.translation:
n. 赃物, 洗劫, 抢夺
v. 洗劫, 抢夺

looted.definition: s. wrongfully emptied or stripped of anything of value
looted.translation: v. 抢劫, 掠夺( loot的过去式和过去分词 )

looter.definition: n someone who takes spoils or plunder (as in war)
looter.translation:
n. 掠夺者, 抢劫者
[法] 掠夺, 抢劫者

looters.definition: n. someone who takes spoils or plunder (as in war)
looters.translation: n. 掠夺者, 抢劫者, 强夺者( looter的复数形式 )

loothsome.translation: a. 讨厌的, 令人恶心的, 可厌的

looting.definition: n. plundering during riots or in wartime
looting.translation: v. 抢劫, 掠夺( loot的现在分词 )

lootings.definition:
plural of looting
n. plundering during riots or in wartime
lootings.translation: (looting 的复数) v. 抢劫, 掠夺( loot的现在分词 )

loots.definition:
n goods or money obtained illegally
n informal terms for money
v take illegally; of intellectual property
v steal goods; take as spoils
loots.translation:
n. 掠夺物( loot的名词复数 ); 钱; 赃物; 被盗物
v. 抢劫, 掠夺( loot的第三人称单数 )
